faq.q: How much does Spahija Law charge?
faq.a: Spahija Law publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Spahija Law offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Spahija Law publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock.

faq.q: Where does Spahija Law have offices?
faq.a: Spahija Law publishes two offices, in Brooklyn and Staten Island. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Spahija Law?
faq.a: Spahija Law names no attorney on the public pages we could read. That is a gap in what the firm publishes rather than a statement about who works there, and it is why the licensure and discipline checks on this profile have nothing to run against.

faq.q: Are the case results Spahija Law publishes verified?
faq.a: No. Spahija Law publishes four case results with amounts on its own site. We counted them and we did not confirm them: the figures are the firm's. Pillar B scores whether a firm publishes outcomes and discloses them properly, including whether a prior-results disclaimer appears beside them, not whether the amounts are right. Past results do not predict another case.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Spahija Law?
faq.a: Spahija Law scores 52 and sits at Listed. Passed: entity registration and footprint. Did not pass: website. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
